tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page. backtide is white first: every web page uses the light theme; dark is for dark slides and dark-mode documents only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Wordmark, headlines, the dot, the tide line, hairlines and the dot button fill, on paper. 19.6:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Long-form body text on paper (legal pages, documents). 13.6:1 light, 13.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper: the line under a headline, labels, notes, footer links, the inactive language. 5.3:1 light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields on paper; the field always has a visible label too. 4.5:1 light, 5.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Glyphs on an ink fill, such as the arrow inside the dot button. Never use a literal white.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background; selected text turns paper.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only, always lowercase. On the landing page it scales with the viewport between 56px and 176px.

styles.name: wordmark-small
styles.usage: The wordmark as a home link at the top of inner pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles of documents. Scale down to 30px on phones.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: One sentence alone on screen. At most once per page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The headline of a message (a crest). Scale down to 21px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The whole workspace, back to any moment.
styles.usage: The line under a headline, in ink-muted. 15px on phones.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: Only the email address you enter in the waitlist form.
styles.usage: Running text in documents, in ink-soft, at most 40rem wide.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: One email when it's ready. Nothing else.
styles.usage: Field labels, notes and status messages, in ink-muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.sample: Privacy policy · Legal notice · EN ES
styles.usage: Footer links and language codes, in ink-muted; the active language in ink.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a field and its dot button.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a crest and its message; footer link groups; document footer padding.

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: fields are a single hairline, never a box. backtide has no cards.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The dot and every circular control (the dot button). The only rounded shape in the system.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: The underline of a field and the rule above a document footer.

tokens.name: stroke-tide
tokens.usage: The tide line. Scale it with the drawing, never thinner than the hairline.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid ink outline, offset 3px (4px around the dot button).

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: The dot button and every tap target.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the waitlist form.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text in documents.

tokens.name: size-message
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a crest message.

app.name: The app
app.usage: The product web (`backtide web`), not the public pages: the landing and the documents stay white first, with no accent colour. In the app, colour carries meaning: who (identity), how serious (risk) and how the agent is (state). White and ink stay the base and Jost the only type. Every colour here is at least 4.5:1 on paper and on its wash, in both themes, and is never the only signal: an agent's colour sits next to its name, a risk is also the dot's shape and its word, a state is always written. The dark theme follows prefers-color-scheme, with a switch.

tokens.name: agent-1
tokens.usage: The identity of the agent in place 1 of the list (blue): its tag, the line on top of its card, its tide and its name in the feed. Always next to the agent's name.

tokens.name: agent-1-wash

tokens.name: risk-0
tokens.usage: Risk 0, normal: a hollow dot in this colour.

tokens.name: risk-1
tokens.usage: Risk 1, to keep in mind: a hollow dot with a thicker ring.

tokens.name: risk-2
tokens.usage: Risk 2, important: a filled dot.

tokens.name: risk-3
tokens.usage: Risk 3, serious: a filled dot with a ring around it; also the count of risk-3 events and a countdown in its last minute.

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: Working: the agent moved in the last minute. A filled dot with a slow pulse, and the word.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: Idle (and stopped, no data): a hollow dot, and the word.

tokens.name: state-frozen
tokens.usage: Paused or frozen: a hollow dot with a thick ring, and the word.

tokens.name: state-waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting for your yes: a filled dot with a quick pulse, the word, and the section of held requests (its line on top, its count, the countdown's line).

tokens.name: state-rewinding
tokens.usage: Rewinding: a filled dot that breathes, and the word.

tokens.name: state-sensor-down
tokens.usage: Sensor down: a filled dot with a quick pulse, and the word. Shares risk-3's red on purpose: it is as serious.

tokens.name: waiting-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of the 'Waiting for your yes' section while it holds requests.

tokens.name: stroke-identity
tokens.usage: An agent's tag and the line on top of its card, of a held request and of the agent bar.
